claims.claim: A JavaScript function declaration uses the function keyword, a name, a parameter list, and a body.
A call invokes a function and supplies argument values; parameters name inputs in the declaration.
A return statement ends function execution and supplies a value to the caller.
When an ordinary function completes without a return value, its call result is undefined.
The worked example totalWithTax(20, 0.05) evaluates to 21.
